name: Directive 66
source:
The year is 20XX. You've been working at MegaCorp since you were 16, and witnessed the company take over the country through election. You were going to continue living on, but one night has changed it all. After the largest attack on POLIGON, the central MegaCorp governmental building, a wounded man asks you to lend him assistance in taking down MegaCorp for good. Will you help him?

[from itch.io]
translation:
时间是20XX年。你从16岁起就在MegaCorp工作，并见证了该公司通过选举接管了国家。你本来要继续活下去，但一个晚上改变了这一切。在对巨型企业中央政府大楼POLIGON进行最大规模的袭击后，一名受伤的男子请求你帮助他永久摧毁巨型企业。你会帮助他吗？

[来自itch.io]
